currentCollection.note: The museum entry describes the stele and its inscription. It does not state when the stone entered the Beilin or whether it is on display.
currentCollection.noteZh: 馆方条目描述了碑石形制与碑文，但没有说明何时入藏碑林、今日是否展出。

provenanceEvents.summary: The Xi’an Beilin Museum records that the original stone stood at Anguo Temple in Tang Chang’an and moved to the Beilin in the Yuanyou era.
provenanceEvents.summaryZh: 西安碑林博物馆记原碑起初立于唐长安安国寺，宋元祐年间移入碑林。

review.note: The earlier collection record was owner-approved on 2026-11-18. The new provenance lead awaits editorial review.
